dependencies.disposition: Deferred tool-only dependency: no inbound W3C Baggage propagation in the retained local emulator/test path. Major OpenTelemetry migration is outside P10.

Deferred tool-only FTP parser: local QA launcher uses HTTP downloads and Auth/Firestore emulators; no FTP target or untrusted directory listing is accepted. Major upgrade is outside the exercised path.
Deferred tool-only glob parser: fixed repository paths and launcher arguments, no user-supplied nested glob input. No patched version listed in OSV; not deployed application code.
Advisory targets v3/v5/v6 with a caller-provided buffer; inspected gaxios path calls v4() without a buffer. No retained route accepts a UUID buffer or invokes affected versions.

Deferred major router migration: retained app uses BrowserRouter client rendering without SSR hydration; navigation targets are fixed local paths or prefixed /students/ and /modules/ paths, never an untrusted complete destination.

manualFindings.disposition: Retained exporter constructs/writes workbooks only. Scanner does not inspect bundled vendor code; replacing style/export stack is deferred unless import is added.
